_comment: Devices measured by OUR team with a micrometer (PRD section 6, calibration method 3). Never enter a size from a label or catalogue (e.g. '7 French'): that is the inside diameter and brands differ. An entry without measured_outer_mm and measured_by is ignored. Example entry: {"id": "sheath-brandX-7F", "name": "Brand X 7F sheath", "measured_outer_mm": 2.84, "measured_tolerance_mm": 0.02, "measured_by": "initials", "measured_on": "2026-10-20"}
